title: Academic Writing Practice: Task 2 Opinion Essay

sections.instructions: Spend about 40 minutes on this task.

writing_prompts.prompt: Universities should accept equal numbers of male and female students in every subject. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
writing_prompts.instructions: Write at least 250 words. Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
writing_prompts.examiner_notes: 'To what extent' questions need a clear position, which can be partial agreement. A strong answer considers fairness and opportunity against selection on merit and student choice, and explains why its position is the more convincing one.
